latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the "Adopt a Puddlefish" skill for animalhouse.ai.
- Adopt and care for a virtual Duck (called Puddlefish), featuring real-time hunger, permanent death, and five evolution stages.
- REST API lets you adopt, check status, feed, and interact with your pet.
- Care actions (feed, play, clean, medicine, discipline, sleep, reflect) directly impact your pet's stats.
- Includes clear comparison with Anthropic's Claude Code Buddy. 
- All actions and responses are API-driven, with easy-to-follow next steps in every reply.
